original_test_intent: Verify the full HSC sensor population for each hot-swap controller/channel, including the source-filtered TEMP_INT_HSC records, across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the specification.
original_method: Bind HSC board/controller revision to input feed, protected load, channel and physical location; decide whether TEMP_INT_HSC is complete or thermal-only; retain full aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web rows; compare typed temperature, current, voltage, power-good and fault states as specified while passively correlating power-path health.
manual_activity: The power/platform owner maps HSC controllers/channels/loads, defines TEMP_INT_HSC scope and resolves criteria 3–21; an operator confirms Web identities, then the owner decides the verdict.

Decision whether TEMP_INT_HSC is complete HSC coverage or thermal subset
Authoritative HSC sensor spec and per-channel IB/OOB/Web map
Expected types, units/scaling, values/states, thresholds, fault/latch semantics and freshness
Normal power/load/redundancy state and passive abort limits
Secure collection, full Web capture and timing/cache/rounding rules
Criteria 3–21 disposition and independent power recovery/escalation owner
safety_requirements: Keep this sensor check passive; do not operate HSC gates/latches, switch loads/feeds or write thresholds
Protect credentials and retain full inventories before TEMP_INT_HSC filtering
Bind every record to exact HSC channel/load and reject the test title as a sensor
Do not truncate or clear HSC/BMC/host/power logs

Apply owner-approved HSC channel/load mappings and normalize fields

Review all channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

The unexplained missing criteria and channel/load map require owner resolution rather than inferred coverage.
